title: Claude Code Session Transcript Line
description: Schema for a single line in a Claude Code JSONL session transcript file (~/.claude/projects/<encoded-cwd>/<sessionId>.jsonl). No official schema exists; record types, fields, and enum domains are derived from source analysis and cross-checked against observed transcripts.
$comment: Record types, fields, and enum domains are source-verified; the version analyzed and the observed-transcript coverage range are in x-claude-code.

envelope.description: Fields merged onto every conversation record at the top level. Grep `logicalParentUuid` to locate the envelope writer.

parentUuid.description: UUID of previous message; null at compact_boundary or first message

isSidechain.description: Whether this is a subagent conversation

teamName.description: Team name if in a team context

userType.description: Build flavor. Public builds hard-code "external"; "ant" only in internal builds.

cwd.description: Working directory at time of write

entrypoint.description: Raw CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT (not validated at write time). Defaults set at startup: cli, sdk-cli (non-interactive, or cli when non-interactive), mcp (`mcp serve`), claude-code-github-action; SDKs set sdk-ts / sdk-py; local_agent is normalized to local-agent. Known set (grep `"claude-coworker-terminal": !0`): cli, mcp, sdk-cli, sdk-ts, sdk-py, bench, claude-vscode, claude-code-github-action, local-agent, claude-desktop, claude-desktop-3p, remote, remote_baku, remote_cowork, remote_trigger, remote_cowork_trigger, remote_desktop, remote_mobile, remote_projects, claude_in_slack, claude-in-slack, claude-in-teams, claude-security, ssh-remote, claude-coworker, claude-coworker-terminal

forkedFrom.description: Source session/message this conversation was forked from

sessionKind.description: Value of CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND when it is one of the listed kinds; omitted otherwise. Written by the envelope helper alongside userType/entrypoint/cwd/sessionId/version. Sessions of kind daemon/daemon-worker are filtered from /resume (grep `filtered from /resume: sessionKind=`).

session_id.description: Snake-case session id stamped by the query engine's output wrapper on every message it yields (grep `[engine] sdkEventQueue push key`); present on records persisted from that stream (user, assistant, attachment, some system) since about 2.1.199, not on every record. Usually equals sessionId; differs on records carried into another session file (branch/relocation), where it keeps the session that first emitted the record

promptId.description: Identifier of the originating prompt; the envelope writer sets it on user records only

oneOf.description: Array of content blocks (text, image, tool_reference)

imageContentBlock.description: Image content block (base64-encoded), used for pasted images and screenshots

documentContentBlock.description: Document content block (e.g. base64-encoded PDF), used for pasted/attached files

id.description: Tool use ID, referenced by subsequent tool_result

caller.description: API-reported invoker of the tool call. Observed only {"type":"direct"}; programmatic tool calling reports a code-execution caller with tool_id

usageObject.description: Token usage from the Anthropic API response

oneOf.description: Per-sampling-iteration usage; a server-side model fallback adds an entry of type "fallback_message"

iterations.description: Iteration count, per-iteration usage array, or null

speed.description: Speed metric (number) or tier name (string, e.g. "standard")

localCommandUsageReport.description: Structured twin of a /usage result, carried on a "local_command" system record as `usageReport` (snake_case keys, identical to the SDK `usage_report` wire field). Grep `Structured twin of a /usage result`. Experimental upstream; the shape may change.

session.description: Cost and usage accumulated by the current session.

model_usage.description: Per-model usage keyed by model id (camelCase inner keys: inputTokens, outputTokens, cacheReadInputTokens, cacheCreationInputTokens, costUSD, contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, thinkingTokens, webSearchRequests, and optionally canonicalModel, costBasis, provider).

rate_limits.description: Plan usage rows and extra-usage spend from the claude.ai usage endpoint; null when the CLI could not fetch them.

limits.description: Server usage rows as sent; null when the server sent none or the fetch is failing.

is_active.description: The row a single-value indicator shows

extra_usage.description: Extra-usage (overage) spend, minor units of currency.

localCommandContextUsage.description: Structured twin of the /context report, carried on a "local_command" system record as `contextUsage` (snake_case keys, identical to the SDK `context_usage` wire field). Grep `Structured twin of the /context report`. Evolves additively.

fallbackContentBlock.description: Server-side model fallback marker. The API streams a `content_block_start` whose content_block has type "fallback" when it swaps models mid-response (e.g. after a refusal); the accumulator switches message.model to `to.model`. Persisted normalized to type/from/to (grep `type: "fallback", from: { model:`). Stripped from assistant content before the history is re-sent to the API. Accompanies usage.iterations[] entries of type "fallback_message" and, on client-stitched refusal fallbacks, the record-level supersedesUuids.

serverContentBlock.description: API server-side content block passed through unchanged into assistant content (the normalizer's default branch keeps any block type it does not heal). Domain is the SDK's server-block list; grep `"text_editor_code_execution_tool_result",` to find it next to "fallback". Not yet observed in local transcripts; advisor_tool_result pairs with the record-level advisorModel.

effortLevel.description: Reasoning effort level (grep `"xhigh", "max"` for the list)

quotaLimits.description: Subscription rate-limit state parsed from the `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-*` response headers of a rejected request. Camel-case sibling of the SDK's `rate_limit_info` (grep `Rate limit information for claude.ai subscription users.`).

oneOf.description: Array of content blocks: tool_result, text, image, or a mix

isVisibleInTranscriptOnly.description: Display-only message, not sent to API

isCompactSummary.description: True when this is a compaction summary

oneOf.description: Structured tool result data. Contents vary by tool. Common fields: stdout, stderr, interrupted, isImage. Grep adds: mode, numFiles, filenames, content, numLines.

content.description: Result content (string or array of content blocks)

oneOf.description: Plain string tool result (e.g. error output)
Array of content blocks (e.g. text blocks from web search results)

imagePasteIds.description: IDs of pasted images (string or integer)

sourceToolUseID.description: Tool use ID that produced this result

sourceToolAssistantUUID.description: UUID of the assistant record that issued the tool call

interruptedMessageId.description: Message ID interrupted by this turn

planContent.description: Plan text when submitted from plan mode

promptSource.description: How the prompt was entered. Grep `case "suggestion_accepted":` for the mapping to user/sdk/system.

thinkingMetadata.description: Present when extended thinking is active

turnOrigin.description: Classified source of the user turn, stamped on the turn's prompt record when it is queried (derived from origin.kind, wakeup source, host initiator, isMeta, promptSource). Values outside the list are deleted on load. Grep `"host_synthetic",` for the list.

turnCompanion.description: True on user records emitted as a side-product of the current turn (meta notes, skill/hook injections, usage-limit wrap-up notes) rather than a new human turn; excluded from turn-boundary and prompt detection. Grep `turnCompanion: !0`.

toolDenialKind.description: Why the tool call in this tool_result did not run. user-rejected = declined at the permission prompt; permission-rule = deny rule, permission mode, or hook; automode-* = auto-mode classifier outcomes; interrupted / cancelled = aborts, not denials. Grep `a denied tool call is persisted as a` for the in-bundle description.

userFeedback.description: Free text the user typed when rejecting a permission prompt (behavior "ask"), also used for AskUserQuestion clarify responses. Forwarded to telemetry as user_feedback.

toolEndsTurn.description: The tool's result declared endsTurn, so the turn ends after this tool_result without another model call (e.g. the structured-output tool, grep `Structured output provided successfully`). The MCP counterpart is `_meta["claude/endTurn"]` in mcpMeta.

classifierMetaLines.description: Auto-mode classifier metadata recorded for the single tool_use_id this result answers: newline-terminated JSON lines of the form {"meta":{...}}, e.g. {"meta":{"gitStatus":{"staged":0,"modified":4,"untracked":3}}}. Grep `JSON.stringify({ meta:`.

classifierBoundary.description: Present (true) when the answered tool call was recorded as classified by the auto-mode classifier, marking a boundary for the classifier's transcript windowing. Only ever written as true.

serverClassifierContext.description: Context sent with a server-side auto-mode classifier request for this tool result. `request` matches serverClassifierRequest on the issuing assistant record.

context.description: Observed keys: git_state (cwd, root, branch, default_branch, status{clean,counts,porcelain,truncated}, visibility{origin,push_remote,remotes,visibility_cache}, or error), live_cwd, platform

queuePriority.description: Stamped on user records built from a queued command whose priority was "later", so a resumed session re-enqueues them at the same priority. Only "later" is ever written.

queueOrigin.description: The task-notification origin of the queued command that produced this record (stamped when origin.kind is "task-notification" and it carries source or slug), kept so a resumed session can re-enqueue it.

queueSkipAttachments.description: Queued command was submitted with skipAttachments (or as a poll event); re-enqueued without ambient attachments on resume.

queueTranscriptOnly.description: Queued command was delivered with shouldQuery false (transcript-only, no model call); re-enqueued with shouldQuery false on resume.

assistantRecord.description: Model response. The same message.id may appear on two consecutive records (streaming artifact).

apiErrorStatus.description: HTTP status of an API error, e.g. 429, 529

error.description: Error code on an API-error record. Known string codes: authentication_failed, oauth_org_not_allowed, account_on_hold, verification_required, billing_error, rate_limit, overloaded, invalid_request, model_not_found, server_error, unknown, max_output_tokens, cloud_credential_error (grep `"cloud_credential_error",`)

isApiErrorMessage.description: Whether this record represents an API error

attributionSkill.description: Skill credited with this turn's work

attributionPlugin.description: Plugin credited with this turn's work

attributionMcpServer.description: MCP server credited with this turn's work

attributionMcpTool.description: MCP tool credited with this turn's work

stop_reason.description: null during streaming. Grep `"model_context_window_exceeded",` for the list.

content.description: Array of thinking, text, and/or tool_use blocks

oneOf.description: Refusal details, e.g. {type:"refusal", category:"cyber", explanation, fallback_has_prefill_claim, recommended_model}; may carry fallback_credit_token

type.description: Observed: previous_message_not_found, tools_changed, messages_changed, system_changed, model_changed, unavailable

input_transformations.description: Server-side edits applied to the request input, e.g. thinking blocks dropped

effort.description: Request-level output_config.effort sent with the API call that produced this record

perTurnEffort.description: Per-turn effort override carried by an api_system block's outputConfig in the request; null when the request had none. Read back on resume to rebuild per-turn effort (preferred over effort when present).

advisorModel.description: Model ID of the advisor tool attached to the request (e.g. "claude-opus-5"); absent when no advisor was active

apiBlockIndex.description: Index of the API response content block this record carries; each streamed block is persisted as its own assistant record sharing message.id

attributionAgent.description: Subagent type credited with this turn, from a querySource of agent:builtin:<name> or agent:custom:<name> (e.g. "general-purpose", "Explore", "plugin:agent")

serverClassifierRequest.description: Key (UUID) of the server-side auto-mode classifier request issued for this record's tool calls; matches serverClassifierContext.request on the resulting tool_result records

wireToolInputs.description: Map of tool_use id to the tool input exactly as received over the wire, before Claude Code's input normalization. Telemetry lane `tether_wire_tool_input`.

wireIngestContext.description: Map of tool_use id to ingest context for Bash calls: { cwd } is the working-directory prefix stripped from the wire command at ingest

isAbortedMidStream.description: Partial text block kept after the stream was aborted (SDK query source or keepPartialMessageOnAbort)

truncatedAfterOutput.description: On an API-error record: the connection dropped after some output had already streamed ("The response above may be incomplete.")

errorDetails.description: Raw error text on an API-error record, e.g. "400 {\"type\":\"error\",...}"

quotaLimits.description: Rate-limit state on an error:"rate_limit" record

supersedesUuids.description: UUIDs of earlier assistant records this one replaces after a model refusal fallback. Telemetry: tengu_refusal_fallback_supersedes (lanes server_stitch, client_retry).

progressRecord.description: Tool/hook progress notification. normalizedMessages in data is always cleared to [] before writing. Legacy: the 2.1.281 source drops progress records before the transcript writer; kept so older transcripts validate.

toolUseID.description: Tool use ID this relates to

data.description: Progress payload, varies by progress type

normalizedMessages.description: Always [] in persisted records (cleared before write)

attachment.description: Payload object, discriminated by the 'type' field

type.description: Attachment subtype discriminator. Open set: each known subtype is checked against its attachment_<subtype> $def through the allOf below; an unknown subtype still validates.

content.description: Rendered message content: a non-empty string, or a non-empty array of text blocks

rendered.description: Frozen model-facing rendering of the attachment, stamped when the attachment record is created (the attachment-message factory calls the renderer and stores each resulting message's content). On load the stored text replaces freshly rendered content when it parses and the message count matches (else each item becomes a meta user message), so a resumed session replays the exact bytes an older CLI sent. Omitted when the attachment renders to nothing, when any rendered message has non-text blocks (e.g. images), for poll_events, and when rendering throws. Observed from 2.1.261. Replaced on edit of the attachment; stripped from queued_command on subagent resume so it re-renders.

content.description: Rendered message content: a non-empty string, or a non-empty array of text blocks

renderedInHumanTurn.description: queued_command only: the alternate rendering used when the queued command is delivered in the same turn as a genuine user message (renderer option inHumanTurn), e.g. the '[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION - NOT USER INPUT] ... delivered in the same turn as a genuine message from the user' framing. Written only when it differs from rendered; same item shape.

subtype.description: System event subtype. "microcompact_boundary" is legacy: the 2.1.281 source no longer writes it; kept so older transcripts validate.

isMeta.description: false on almost every system subtype the current source writes; true on "file_snapshot"; absent on "api_error", "stop_hook_summary" and "upgrade_relay_marker" (and on "compact_boundary" rebuilt from an SDK frame). Older schema text claiming it is always true was wrong.

content.description: Human-readable text. Absent on "turn_duration", "api_error", "stop_hook_summary", "memory_saved", "agents_killed". On "model_refusal_no_fallback" the loop writes an empty string. On "upgrade_relay_marker" it is a JSON string (the relay marker, carrying anchor_line_uuid).

compactMetadata.description: Present when subtype is "compact_boundary". Grep `cumulativeDroppedTokens` / `preCompactDiscoveredTools` for the writers; SDK twin is `compact_metadata`.

userContext.description: User focus text for a manual "summarize from here"

messagesSummarized.description: Count of messages the compaction summarized

cumulativeDroppedTokens.description: Running total of tokens removed by this and every earlier compaction

durationMs.description: Compaction wall time (user-wait from the prompt-too-long point when precomputed)

precomputed.description: Summary was generated in the background at the autocompact threshold

preCompactDiscoveredTools.description: Deferred-tool names discovered before this compaction

preservedSegment.description: Relink info for kept messages (legacy; superseded by preservedMessages)

preservedMessages.description: Ordered kept-message UUIDs; uuids is the on-disk subset, allUuids the in-memory superset

cause.description: Legacy: present on "api_error" records from older versions only; the 2.1.281 api_error builder no longer sets it.

error.description: Present when subtype is "api_error". Current source writes a plain-data snapshot (grep `anthropic-ratelimit-unified-representative-claim` for its builder): message, status?, requestId?, formatted, connection ({code, message, isSSLError} or null), isNetworkDown, rateLimits ({rateLimitType?, resetsAt?} or null), noResponse ({waitedMs, retryWaitMs} or null), isCloudCredentialError?. Transcripts from older versions hold a serialized APIError instead (status, headers, requestID, error, type) or {cause, type}.

retryInMs.description: Present when subtype is "api_error", may be fractional

toolUseID.description: "stop_hook_summary" and "informational" (tool-scoped banners): the tool_use id the record belongs to, used to dedupe progress banners.

upgradeNudge.description: "bridge_status" only: upgrade-prompt text shown beside the /remote-control banner.

url.description: "bridge_status" (the /remote-control URL; grep `/remote-control is active`) and "cloud_session_status" (the cloud session URL).

source.description: "api_error" only: which retry path emitted the record. Only "request_retry" is written in 2.1.281; absent on older records.

entry.description: "cloud_session_status" only: whether this session created or attached to the cloud session (grep `Cloud session active`, `Attached to cloud session`).

hookAdditionalContext.description: "stop_hook_summary" only: non-error feedback from hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext, kept apart from hookErrors. Absent on records written before the field existed.

hookLabel.description: "stop_hook_summary" only: display label. Defined by the builder but the only 2.1.281 caller passes undefined, so not currently persisted.

totalDurationMs.description: "stop_hook_summary" only: total hook wall time. Defined by the builder but the only 2.1.281 caller passes undefined, so not currently persisted.

preventContinuation.description: "informational" only: when true, execution stopped after this banner (e.g. a hook denied continuation).

budgetTokens.description: "turn_duration" only: output tokens spent this turn toward the token budget (present when a turn token budget is active).

commandRun.description: "local_command" only: the run that printed the row: command name (no slash) and its argument string as echoed (`***` when sensitive). Absent on a never-ran notice.

commandOutcome.description: "local_command" only: what the row reports, so a host can offer a fix. Absent when none applies; new kinds are additive.

suggestion.description: For kind "unknown": closest registered command name, no slash

commands.description: "permission_retry" only: display names of the commands a permission-mode change allowed; content is `Allowed <commands>`.

trigger.description: "model_refusal_fallback" (always "refusal") and "model_fallback" (the primary-model failure that caused the swap).

direction.description: "model_refusal_fallback" only. Only "retry" is emitted by current source; "revert" and "sticky" are retained upstream for compat and may appear in old transcripts.

scope.description: "model_refusal_fallback" only: "session" when the main thread fell back and the session model is swapped; "local" when only a subagent / side-question / background fork response came from the fallback model. Absent on older records (treat as "session").

originalModelName.description: "model_consent_fallback" only: display name the usage-credit copy uses for originalModel (e.g. "Fable 5").

requestId.description: "model_refusal_fallback" and "model_refusal_no_fallback": API request id of the refused response.

apiRefusalCategory.description: "model_refusal_fallback" and "model_refusal_no_fallback": refusal category from stop_details.category (e.g. "cyber", "bio"); open string; null when no category was carried.

apiRefusalExplanation.description: "model_refusal_fallback" and "model_refusal_no_fallback": stop_details.explanation, display-only prose; null when absent (always null on the session-scope retry banner).

refusedUserMessageUuid.description: "model_refusal_fallback" and "model_refusal_no_fallback": uuid of the user message the refused request answered (rewind / edit-and-retry target); null when the turn was not human-authored.

retractedMessageUuids.description: "model_refusal_fallback" only: uuids of messages (the refused partial, tombstoned tool_results) this fallback retracted.

sawCyberRefusal.description: "model_refusal_fallback" only: present when any hop of the multi-hop refusal episode was a cyber refusal.

provisional.description: "model_refusal_fallback" only: a provisional banner flushed mid-episode, later tombstoned and superseded by the resolved banner.

choice.description: "model_consent_fallback" only: the consent-prompt answer that produced the swap (grep `requires usage credits`).

persistedAsDefault.description: "model_consent_fallback" only: true when the decline also rewrote the saved default model.

writtenPaths.description: "memory_saved" only: memory file paths written (grep `[extractMemories] writtenPaths=`).

teamCount.description: "memory_saved" only: how many of the writes were team memories.

verb.description: "memory_saved" only: banner verb, renders as "<verb> N memories" (default "Saved"; "Improved" from the memory-improve path).

snapshotFiles.description: "file_snapshot" only: session files captured for rewind (grep `Plan over snapshot cap`).

key.description: File kind; upstream docs also mention 'todo'

taskId.description: "scheduled_task_fire" only: id of the scheduled (cron) task that fired.

prompt.description: "scheduled_task_fire" only: the task prompt, truncated to 200 characters.

taskKind.description: "scheduled_task_fire" only: present when the task is a /loop task.

cronKind.description: "scheduled_task_fire" only: present on /loop wakeups (grep `Claude resuming /loop wakeup`).

noOpStreak.description: "scheduled_task_fire" only: consecutive no-op /loop ticks folded into this record (grep `loop_noop_fold`).

streakStartedAt.description: "scheduled_task_fire" only: when the folded no-op streak began.

foldedUuids.description: "scheduled_task_fire" only: uuids of the prior no-op span folded under this fire.

aiTitleRecord.description: Auto-generated session title, distinct from the user-set custom-title. Metadata-only (no envelope).

lastPromptRecord.description: Most recent user prompt for the session. Metadata-only (no envelope).

leafUuid.description: Leaf message UUID; null on an explicit checkpoint that rewinds to before the first message

explicit.description: Leaf was set explicitly (rewind/branch checkpoint), not inferred from the last message

rewound.description: Explicit checkpoint produced by a rewind

agentSetting.description: agentType of the main-thread agent the session runs as (from --agent or the `agent` setting), e.g. "general-purpose". Written beside `type: "agent-setting"` in the session-metadata re-append; last one wins on load.

modeRecord.description: Mode change. Metadata-only (no envelope). Distinct from the permission-mode record.

permissionModeRecord.description: Active permission mode. Metadata-only (no envelope). Distinct from the mode record.

summaryRecord.description: Session summary, written at session end. Keyed by leafUuid on read. Metadata-only (no envelope).

leafUuid.description: UUID of the last assistant message

fileHistorySnapshotRecord.description: File state snapshot, written before each user turn. Metadata-only (no envelope).

messageId.description: UUID of the associated user message

trackedFileBackups.description: Map of file paths to backup data

reason.description: Why a queued command was removed (remove operations). Values in 2.1.281: absorbed_mid_turn, delivered_as_tool_result, delivered_to_agent, cleared_on_cancel, dropped_by_hook, agent_stopped, resume_failed, cancelled_by_sender

speculationAcceptRecord.description: Speculation accept event. Metadata-only (no envelope). Legacy: the 2.1.281 source no longer writes it; kept so older transcripts validate.

bridgeSessionId.description: Bridge session identifier, e.g. "cse_01..."; empty string when the link was cleared

declaredDialogKinds.description: Dialog kinds the remote client declared it can render

noHistoryBackfill.description: Present when the bridge must not backfill prior history

ownerAccountUuid.description: Account that owned the bridge session; a mismatch on reattach suppresses history

worktreeStateRecord.description: Git worktree session state. Metadata-only (no envelope).

worktreeSession.description: Worktree session details, or null when not in a worktree

atisLatchRecord.description: Conversation-scoped latch of the server ATIS pin (sent on API requests as the `x-cc-atis` header). Latched on the first request of a conversation from the cached bootstrap clientData `atis` value, re-stamped whenever the latch differs from the last stamp written to this transcript file, re-appended with session metadata, and copied into --fork-session / branch transcripts. Metadata-only (no envelope); last-wins on read.

atis.description: Opaque printable-ASCII pin, e.g. 16 hex chars or a dotted `v1.<id>.<...>.<...>.<...>` token. Empty string means the conversation latched with no ATIS pin (no header is sent); readers ignore values outside printable ASCII

continuedInSessionRecord.description: Written to the parent session's transcript when the session is sent to the background (left-arrow or the background command forks it into a background session). Points to the session that continues the conversation; /resume filters the parent out while the successor exists. Metadata-only (no envelope); cleared by a compact boundary on load.

continuedInSessionId.description: Session UUID of the background session that continues this conversation

costStateRecord.description: Session cost/usage ledger snapshot, restored on resume. Written by an exit re-stamp provider at process exit and when the conversation is reset (/clear). Readers drop the record unless every numeric field is a finite non-negative number and totalCostUSD <= 1e9. Metadata-only (no envelope); last-wins on read.

modelUsage.description: Map of model name (no control/format characters) to usage totals

thinkingTokens.description: Omitted when the model reported no thinking-token count

hasUnknownModelCost.description: True when some usage came from a model with no known price

fileHistoryDeltaRecord.description: Incremental file-history entry: one tracked file's backup added to the latest snapshot when an edit tool first touches that file in a turn, instead of rewriting the whole file-history-snapshot. Grouped by messageId on load and folded into the matching snapshot. Metadata-only (no envelope, no sessionId); cleared by a compact boundary on load.

messageId.description: UUID of the user message whose turn made the edit

snapshotMessageId.description: messageId of the file-history snapshot the backup is added to

trackingPath.description: Tracked file path, relative to the project when inside it

backup.description: File-history backup descriptor (same shape as the values of file-history-snapshot trackedFileBackups)

backupFileName.description: Backup file name under the file-history directory; null when the tracked file did not exist (new or deleted file)

realParentDir.description: Symlink-resolved parent directory of the tracked file, used to refuse restores through a changed path; absent in records from older versions

forkContextRefRecord.description: Written as the first record of a forked subagent's sidechain transcript (subagents/agent-<agentId>.jsonl) when the fork inherits the parent conversation verbatim: instead of copying the parent's messages it references them by the parent's last message UUID and message count. Routed to the agent's transcript by agentId. Metadata-only (no envelope, no sessionId).

parentLastUuid.description: UUID of the last parent message included in the inherited context

frameLinkRecord.description: Link to a published Artifact (claude.ai artifact page). The Artifact tool writes the full form (path, frameUrl, title, artifactCount) on publish; the session-metadata re-append writes a count-only form (artifactCount, sessionId, timestamp). Readers take the session's artifact count as max(artifactCount, distinct frameUrl). Metadata-only (no envelope).

artifactCount.description: Distinct artifacts published in the session so far; absent in records from older versions

historySuppressionRecord.description: Taint marker: this session's history must not be backfilled/mirrored to a remote-control (bridge) session, e.g. because the signed-in account changed since the bridge pointer was saved. Any occurrence marks the session suppressed. Metadata-only (no envelope).

cause.description: Why history was suppressed. Values in 2.1.281: migration (re-append of an already-suppressed session), fork_inherit (fork of a suppressed session), meta_seed, chokepoint_veto, restored_owner_mismatch, env_owner_mismatch

vetoedAgainstAccountUuid.description: Account UUID the reattach was vetoed against; present on account-mismatch vetoes

relocatedRecord.description: Session working directory moved: written when the session's cwd changes to another project directory (e.g. entering a worktree) and the transcript is relocated there; re-appended with session metadata and copied into forks. On read it overrides the head record's cwd. Metadata-only (no envelope); last-wins on read.

artifactCommentMonitorRecord.description: Which published artifacts this session is watching for comments (armed) or has stopped watching, so monitors survive resume. Written when the watch set changes and at exit; on a torn tail, armed entries without a holder are rewritten as stopped. Multiple records are merged per artifact on load. Metadata-only (no envelope).

artifacts.description: Map of artifact ID to monitor intent (at most 64 kept, armed first)

holder.description: "bg" when the monitor is held by a background session

artifactAutoreactLedgerRecord.description: Artifact comment auto-react ledger: per artifact, which comment threads/comments have been seen and delivered to the model, so auto-reactions are not repeated after resume. Written (debounced, and at exit) when the ledger changes; ignored on read if sessionId differs, and flagged when accountUuid differs from the signed-in account. Metadata-only (no envelope); last-wins on read.

accountUuid.description: Lower-cased account UUID of the signed-in user, or null

artifacts.description: Map of artifact ID to ledger entry

activatedAt.description: Server timestamp the thread became auto-react eligible

sent.description: [commentId, sentAt|null] pairs of comments delivered to the model

contentReplacementRecord.description: Oversized tool results replaced in context by a persisted-output stub (per-message tool result budget); records the replacement text so resume re-applies it byte-identically. Routed to the subagent transcript when agentId is set. Copied into forks. Metadata-only (no envelope).

agentId.description: Subagent ID when the replacement belongs to a subagent conversation

endedByModelRecord.description: Marker written when the model ends the conversation via the end-conversation tool; the session is then treated as ended on resume. Metadata-only (no envelope).

isolationLatchRecord.description: Web-search / connector isolation latch: once a session uses web tools (side "web") or connectors (side "connectors") under an organization isolation policy, the other side is blocked for the rest of the session. Metadata-only (no envelope); last-wins on read.

memoryModeRecord.description: Memory on/off toggle stamp, anchored after a conversation message; all stamps accumulate and are replayed on resume (carried across /clear with afterUuid null). Metadata-only (no envelope).

afterUuid.description: Message the toggle applies after, or null

reason.description: Why memory was toggled; readers keep only paused, session_shape, server_off

observerRefRecord.description: Agent-observer delivery marker: an observer agent received a batch of events from the observed agent. Routed to the observed subagent's transcript when agentId is set; the last one is read back to re-attach the observer. Metadata-only (no envelope, no sessionId).

attachment_advisor_stripped.description: Marker that advisor tool blocks were stripped from history ('strip_and_mark'), also appended by manual /compact and conversation rewind. Renders to nothing.

attachment_advisor_tool.description: Advisor-tool availability change. Rendered from a discriminated union on `available` (add: model announced; remove: tool withdrawn). Belongs to the context-announcement set preserved across compaction.

available.description: Whether the advisor tool is available

abbreviated.description: available only: announce in abbreviated form

byBase.description: unavailable only: the base model decides (no separate advisor)

attachment_agent_listing_delta.description: Incremental announcement of Agent-tool subagent types (added/removed since the last delta). Rendered as 'Available agent types for the Agent tool:' (isInitial) or 'New agent types are now available for the Agent tool:'. Landmark: type: "agent_listing_delta", showConcurrencyNote.

addedLines.description: Rendered listing line per added agent type ('- <type>: <description> (Tools: ...)')

isInitial.description: True when no agent types had been announced earlier in the transcript

showConcurrencyNote.description: Append the 'send them in a single message with multiple tool uses' note

attachment_agent_mention.description: User @-mentioned an agent (@agent-<type>); rendered as 'The user has expressed a desire to invoke the agent'. Landmarks: tengu_at_mention_agent_success, type: "agent_mention".

attachment_already_read_file.description: @-mentioned file whose content is already in context (unchanged since last read); not rendered to the model (renderer returns []). Landmark: type: "already_read_file" in the at-mention file reader.

content.description: Read output: a synthesized 'text' variant from readFileState, or the Read tool's 'file_unchanged' variant

file.description: Variant payload: text {filePath, content, numLines, startLine, totalLines, truncatedByTokenCap?}; image {base64, type, originalSize, dimensions?}; notebook {filePath, cells}; pdf {filePath, base64, originalSize}; parts {filePath, originalSize, count, outputDir}; file_unchanged {filePath}

source.description: file_unchanged only: dedup matched a startup-seeded CLAUDE.md/nested-memory entry

attachment_artifact_opening_prefetch.description: Artifact-opening prefetch: pre-read page/design-system content injected on the first turn of an artifact-editing session. Rendered as a system reminder of content; design-system failures log '[artifactOpeningPrefetch] design-system entry failed'.

kind.description: Absent for the page prefetch; 'design_system' for the design-system note

slug.description: Artifact slug the prefetch belongs to

typeFiles.description: Artifact type files descriptor (page prefetch only)

attachment_async_hook_response.description: Delivered result of a hook that ran asynchronously (async: true). response.systemMessage and response.hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext are rendered to the model. Landmark: 'getAsyncHookResponseAttachments', type: "async_hook_response".

hookEvent.description: Hook event name (open set, e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostModelSwitch, Notification)

toolName.description: Tool the hook ran for (set by 2.1.281's constructor; omitted when undefined)

attachment_async_hook_response_batch.description: UI-only collapse of consecutive async_hook_response records into one row; synthesized when grouping messages for display, not written by the transcript writer. Renders to nothing.

hooks.description: Collapsed responses grouped by hook event

attachment_at_mention_reference.description: @-mentioned paths that were referenced but not read (sessions where file contents are not auto-attached). Rendered as 'The user @-mentioned <paths>. File contents are not attached automatically in this session'.

attachment_attention_budget.description: Named in the context-announcement type set and renderer (renders to nothing); no constructor in 2.1.281, payload unknown.

attachment_audio_transcript.description: @-mentioned audio file transcribed with Anthropic speech-to-text. Renderer only in 2.1.281 (no constructor in the bundle): 'The user @-mentioned the audio file <f>. Claude Code transcribed it' with an <audio-transcript filename=... duration=...> block, or '... but Claude Code could not transcribe it.'

attachment_auto_mode.description: Auto-mode (or bypassPermissions) steering reminder; rendered as the '## Auto Mode Active' block or 'While auto mode is active:' / 'While bypass permissions mode is active:' Bash-first steer. Field set is version-dependent: reminderType (<=2.1.144), autoModeConsentFlow (>=2.1.204), bashFirst/steerOnly/bypass (>=2.1.234), bashFirstSteer (>=2.1.261). Landmark: type: "auto_mode", bashFirstSteer.

reminderType.description: Legacy (<=2.1.144): full vs sparse reminder cadence

autoModeConsentFlow.description: Include the consent-batching guidance ('When the auto-mode classifier blocks an action')

bashFirst.description: Include the Bash-first steer (do work via Bash rather than Read/Edit/Write)

bashFirstSteer.description: Bash-first wording variant; present only when bashFirst (env CLAUDE_CODE_COZY_TEAPOT overrides)

steerOnly.description: Emit only the Bash-first steer, not the full auto-mode block

bypass.description: Permission mode is bypassPermissions rather than auto

attachment_auto_mode_exit.description: Left auto mode; rendered as '## Exited Auto Mode'. bashFirst/steerOnly copied from the last auto_mode record (>=2.1.263; absent earlier or when that record lacked them). Landmark: type: "auto_mode_exit".

bashFirst.description: Append 'Resume using the dedicated tools for file reads, searches, and edits.'

attachment_bash_output_audience_note.description: Follows a Bash tool result to tell the model 'Only you see that command's output'. Landmark: type: "bash_output_audience_note". First observed 2.1.261.

toolUseID.description: tool_use id of the Bash call

attachment_batching_reminder.description: Tool-batching reminder injected into the API request only (inserted after the last assistant turn at request time, not persisted); its persisted counterpart is batching_reminder_sent.

text.description: Reminder text, e.g. 'First privately list what you need next; then request every item that doesn't depend on another's result in this one response.'

attachment_batching_reminder_sent.description: Record of the tool-batching reminder text that was sent to the model (not re-rendered; renderer returns []); used to dedupe and to replay the reminder on the next user message. Sibling of secondary_reminder_sent. Landmarks: "batching_reminder_sent", clearAt: "next_user_message".

model.description: Reminder model id the text was chosen for

clearAt.description: Set on the records emitted by the 'kept' delivery path

attachment_budget_usd.description: USD budget status when a max USD budget is set (SDK/print --max-budget-usd); rendered as 'USD budget: $<used>/$<total>; $<remaining> remaining'. Landmark: type: "budget_usd".

attachment_command_permissions.description: Tool allowlist (and model override) carried by an invoked slash command / skill with allowed-tools frontmatter; not rendered to the model. Landmark: type: "command_permissions".

allowedTools.description: Permission rules granted for the command's turn

model.description: Model override from the command frontmatter (omitted when none)

attachment_compact_file_reference.description: Post-compaction pointer to a previously read file too large to re-inline; rendered as 'was read before the last conversation was summarized, but the contents are too large to include'. Landmark: type: "compact_file_reference".

attachment_context_efficiency.description: Named in type sets and renderer (renders to nothing); no constructor in 2.1.281, payload unknown.

attachment_context_sections.description: Remaining userContext/systemContext entries (other than claudeMd, currentDate, userEmail, attachedProject, gitStatus, perforceMode, workerToolsContext, cacheBreaker) announced as sections (context-announcement family). Rendered as '# <name>\n<text>' blocks.

attachment_coordinator_context.description: Coordinator-mode worker-tools announcement (context-announcement family): the workerToolsContext key drained out of userContext. Rendered as content (prefixed 'The worker tools have changed; this replaces the earlier list.' when changed); empty content with changed renders 'Coordinator mode has ended; the earlier list of worker tools no longer applies.'

content.description: Worker-tools context text ('' when coordinator mode ended)

attachment_cowork_memory_context.description: Cowork memory snapshot for the turn. content null means a withdrawn snapshot ('The previous memory snapshot was withdrawn; disregard it.'). Records with leg 'laptop' are never written to the transcript.

content.description: Memory snapshot text (guidance + content + version notes), or null when withdrawn

attachment_credential_org.description: Records the organization UUID of the credentials in use, written when it first appears or changes; not rendered (a change may add the warning 'Signed in to a different account or organization than earlier in this conversation'). Landmarks: context_credential_org_change, type: "credential_org". First observed 2.1.281.

attachment_critical_system_reminder.description: Experimental per-turn critical reminder (criticalSystemReminder_EXPERIMENTAL); content rendered verbatim.

attachment_date.description: Context announcement of the current local date (replaces the currentDate user-context line); rendered as "Today's date is <date>." or, with changed, "The date has changed. Today's date is now <date>.". Landmark: type: "date" in the context-announcement builder (tengu_context_announcement). >=2.1.251.

changed.description: Set when a different date was announced earlier (>=2.1.261)

attachment_date_change.description: Legacy date-rollover notice (observed <=2.1.263; superseded by `date` with changed: true, no constructor in 2.1.281 but still rendered on replay as 'The date has changed. Today's date is now <newDate>.'). Landmark: date_change renderer, newDate.

attachment_deferred_tools_delta.description: Incremental announcement of deferred (ToolSearch-loadable) tools and MCP server status; rendered as 'The following deferred tools are now available via ToolSearch...', 'no longer available', 'still connecting', 'failed to connect', 'require authentication'. Landmarks: tengu_deferred_tools_pool_change, tengu_inline_tools_announced, type: "deferred_tools_delta".

addedLines.description: Rendered listing line per added tool

wireHiddenNames.description: Tools still present but hidden from the wire tool list (>=2.1.251)

readdedNames.description: Tools available again after being removed (>=2.1.128)

pendingMcpServers.description: MCP servers still connecting (full current list)

needsAuthMcpServers.description: MCP servers needing OAuth (full current list)

failedMcpServers.description: MCP servers that failed to connect (full current list, sorted by name)

retractedTools.description: Tools whose loaded definitions must be disregarded because their source was removed

cause.description: Revocation kind: policy_blocked | org_blocked | denied | disabled | not_configured | unclassified (open set)

surfacedNames.description: Tools whose full definitions are inlined (or name-only surfaced) with this delta (>=2.1.273)

surfacedDefinitions.description: Inline tool definitions: {name, listing, definition} or pointer {name, listing, sameAs}

replacedNames.description: Tools whose inlined definitions replace earlier ones

removedByBlock.description: Inline-defined tools withdrawn ('Do not call them')

toolSearchAbsent.description: ToolSearch unavailable: tools are announced as directly callable

attachment_deferred_tools_record.description: Persistence record of deferred-tool definitions as sent on the wire, so a resumed session can replay the same tool schemas; not rendered (renderer returns []). Landmark: type: "deferred_tools_record", toolInputCopies. >=2.1.261.

entries.description: API tool definitions new or changed since the last record

nameOnlyAnnouncements.description: uuids of deferred_tools_delta records announced name-only

strippedReferences.description: Tool references stripped from the wire

toolInputCopies.description: Which copy of a tool_use input was sent for a given id

attachment_diagnostics.description: New IDE (MCP) or LSP diagnostics; rendered inside <new-diagnostics>. Landmarks: tengu_lsp_diagnostics_injected, 'LSP Diagnostics: getLSPDiagnosticAttachments called'.

attachment_dir_sync_notice.description: Directory-sync notice drained from the session's dir-sync queue (CLAUDE_CODE_DIR_SYNC_GIT).

attachment_directory.description: User @-mentioned a directory; rendered as a synthetic Bash `ls` tool_use/tool_result pair. Landmark: tengu_at_mention_extracting_directory_success.

content.description: Newline-joined entry names (max 1000, then '… and N more entries')

attachment_dynamic_skill.description: Skills discovered in a newly touched directory under the cwd. Rendered as 'New skills discovered in <dir>, now available via the Skill tool:'.

attachment_edited_image_file.description: A watched image file changed on disk; carries the re-read (compressed) image. Renders to nothing directly. Compression failure logs tengu_watched_file_compression_failed.

content.description: Image read result (type 'image' with base64 file data)

attachment_edited_text_file.description: A previously read file changed on disk; rendered as 'Note: <file> changed on disk since you last read it'. Empty snippet means changes are not shown. Landmark: type: "edited_text_file".

snippet.description: Changed lines with line numbers, or '' when not shown

displayPath.description: Legacy: observed only on 2.1.170-2.1.247 records; not set by 2.1.281's constructor

attachment_environment.description: Context announcement carrying the '# Environment' section (formerly in the system prompt): 'You have been invoked in the following environment: '. Without changes it is a full copy; with changes it renders as '# Environment update'. Landmark: type: "environment", snapshot. >=2.1.251.

snapshot.description: Full environment snapshot (always the current state)

items.description: One changed field relative to the previous snapshot

attachment_file.description: User @-mentioned (or compaction re-attached) a file; rendered as a synthetic Read tool_use/tool_result pair. Landmarks: tengu_at_mention_extracting_filename_success, type: "file" with truncated.

content.description: Read tool output for the file

file.description: Variant payload: text {filePath, content, numLines, startLine, totalLines, truncatedByTokenCap?}; image {base64, type, originalSize, dimensions?}; notebook {filePath, cells}; pdf {filePath, base64, originalSize}; parts {filePath, originalSize, count, outputDir}; file_unchanged {filePath}

source.description: file_unchanged only: dedup matched a startup-seeded CLAUDE.md/nested-memory entry

truncated.description: Content was cut to the first N lines because the file was too large

attachment_fork_briefing.description: Briefing written as the first record of a forked session (e.g. 'This conversation was forked from a session that is still working in this checkout'); rendered inside a system reminder. Landmark: type: "fork_briefing".

attachment_goal_status.description: /goal condition status written by the Stop-hook evaluator: not met (met false, reason), met (met true, iterations/durationMs/tokens), impossible (failed true), or a sentinel marker (sentinel true; met true on clear, met false to re-assert an active goal). Not rendered. Landmarks: tengu_goal_achieved, tengu_goal_failed.

attachment_hook_additional_context.description: additionalContext returned by hooks (or a PostToolUse formatter re-sync note); rendered as '<hookName> hook additional context: ...'. Landmark: type: "hook_additional_context".

content.description: Context strings, joined by newlines when rendered

toolUseID.description: tool_use id the hook ran for, or a synthetic id ('SessionStart', 'hook-<uuid>', a uuid) for non-tool events

hookEvent.description: Hook event name (open set, e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostModelSwitch, Notification)

attachment_hook_blocking_error.description: A hook blocked (exit 2 / decision block); rendered as '<hookName> hook blocking error from command: "<command>": <blockingError>'. Landmark: type: "hook_blocking_error".

toolUseID.description: tool_use id the hook ran for, or a synthetic id ('SessionStart', 'hook-<uuid>', a uuid) for non-tool events

hookEvent.description: Hook event name (open set, e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostModelSwitch, Notification)

attachment_hook_cancelled.description: A tool hook was cancelled (abort/timeout). Emitted for PreToolUse/PostToolUse/PostToolUseFailure and by the generic hook runner. Renders to nothing.

attachment_hook_deferred_tool.description: A PreToolUse hook deferred the tool call (tool not run now). Renders to nothing.

traceparent.description: W3C traceparent for the deferred call

attachment_hook_error_during_execution.description: A hook threw/failed to execute. Renders to nothing.

attachment_hook_non_blocking_error.description: A hook failed without blocking (non-zero non-2 exit, spawn failure, HTTP/prompt hook error); not rendered. stderr is prefixed e.g. 'Failed with non-blocking status code:' / 'Failed to run:'. Landmark: type: "hook_non_blocking_error".

toolUseID.description: tool_use id the hook ran for, or a synthetic id ('SessionStart', 'hook-<uuid>', a uuid) for non-tool events

hookEvent.description: Hook event name (open set, e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostModelSwitch, Notification)

attachment_hook_permission_decision.description: A PermissionRequest hook decided a tool permission. Renders to nothing.

decision.description: Permission behavior returned by the hook, e.g. 'allow' or 'deny'

attachment_hook_plugin_listing.description: Named only in the non-turn attachment type set; no constructor or renderer in 2.1.281, payload unknown.

attachment_hook_stopped_continuation.description: A hook stopped continuation (continue:false). Rendered as '<hookName> hook stopped continuation: <message>'.

message.description: stopReason from the hook, or the default stop text

attachment_hook_success.description: A hook completed successfully; rendered ('<hookName> hook success: <content>') only for SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit and UserPromptExpansion with non-empty content. Prompt/agent hooks omit the process fields. Landmark: type: "hook_success".

toolUseID.description: tool_use id the hook ran for, or a synthetic id ('SessionStart', 'hook-<uuid>', a uuid) for non-tool events

hookEvent.description: Hook event name (open set, e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostModelSwitch, Notification)

attachment_hook_system_message.description: A hook's systemMessage output, shown to the user (not rendered to the model). Landmark: type: "hook_system_message", heldForServedCall.

toolUseID.description: tool_use id the hook ran for, or a synthetic id ('SessionStart', 'hook-<uuid>', a uuid) for non-tool events

hookEvent.description: Hook event name (open set, e.g. PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, SessionStart, Setup, UserPromptSubmit, UserPromptExpansion, Stop, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PostModelSwitch, Notification)

heldForServedCall.description: Message held for a call served for a cloud session

attachment_inlined_image_paths.description: Image paths inlined into a user prompt, re-announced as a reminder. Excluded from rewind points.

attachment_instructions.description: Context announcement carrying CLAUDE.md / memory instruction files (formerly the claudeMd user-context block): 'Contents of <path> (<kind>):'. Later records with changed carry only differing files and 'Instructions no longer present: <path>' removals. Landmark: type: "instructions", 'Instruction files were re-read'. >=2.1.261.

changed.description: Delta relative to earlier instructions records

reason.description: Refresh reason; set only with changed

attachment_invoked_skills.description: Skills invoked earlier in the session, re-announced after compaction so their guidance survives. Built by the post-compact skill re-attach (sorted by invokedAt, token-capped). Rendered as 'The following skills were invoked EARLIER in this session (before the conversation was compacted)' with one '### Skill: <name>' block each. Transcript load drops the record unless `skills` is an array of objects ('transcript load: dropped').

path.description: Path of the SKILL.md the body came from (rendered as 'Path: <path>')

content.description: Skill body, possibly truncated to the per-skill re-attach cap

attachment_language.description: Response-language announcement (context-announcement family, emitted with output_style_instructions by the 'session_settings' producer). Rendered as '# Language\nAlways respond in <lang>.' or 'The language preference was cleared. Match the user's language.' when null.

language.description: Configured language (length-capped), or null when cleared

attachment_max_turns_reached.description: The agent loop hit --max-turns / maxTurns. Renders to nothing.

attachment_mcp_dropped_tools_delta.description: MCP tools excluded because their input schemas would be rejected by the API. Rendered as '# Unavailable MCP Tools'. Emission logs tengu_mcp_dropped_tools_pool_change.

addedEntries.description: Lines '"<tool>" (MCP server "<server>"): "<reason>"' or 'MCP server "<s>": N tools excluded (invalid input schema)'

attachment_mcp_instructions_delta.description: Incremental MCP server-instructions announcement: servers whose instructions appeared or changed since the last delta, and servers that disconnected. Rendered as '# MCP Server Instructions' / 'The following MCP servers have provided instructions for how to use their tools and resources:' and 'The following MCP servers have disconnected. Their instructions above no longer apply:'. Emission logs tengu_mcp_instructions_pool_change.

addedNames.description: Server names whose instruction blocks are (re)announced, sorted; parallel to addedBlocks

addedBlocks.description: Instruction blocks, each '## <server>\n<instructions>' (plus any client-side block such as the computer-use or claude-in-chrome guidance)

addedServerInstructions.description: Raw server-provided instructions per added server (parallel to addedNames; '' when the block is client-side only). Present only when the change-detection gate is on; lets a later delta detect a changed instructions string

removedNames.description: Servers that disconnected since the previous announcement, sorted

attachment_mcp_resource.description: @-mentioned MCP resource with its read result. Rendered as 'Full contents of resource:' ... or <mcp-resource server=... uri=...>(No content)</mcp-resource>. Excluded from rewind points.

attachment_memory_update.description: Memory directory changed in the background. Rendered as '<Background memory consolidation> updated your memory directory: <summary>' with 'Files changed:' and stale-copy notes, or the bare summary for 'sync_unsaved'.

inContextPaths.description: Changed files whose loaded copies are now stale

attachment_model.description: Model-identity announcement (context-announcement family, observed from 2.1.251). Emitted when the main-loop model identity differs from the last announced one. Rendered from `text`, e.g. 'You are powered by the model named <marketingName>. The exact model ID is <modelId>.' + 'Assistant knowledge cutoff is <cutoff>.'; the section is cached under the prompt-section key 'env_info_model'.

identity.description: Model identity snapshot; later turns compare it field-by-field to decide whether to re-announce

modelId.description: Exact model ID, e.g. 'claude-opus-5-5' (may carry a '[1m]' suffix in other fields but not here)

marketingName.description: Marketing name, e.g. 'Opus 5.5'; null when unknown

knowledgeCutoff.description: Knowledge cutoff, e.g. 'June 2026'; null when unknown

text.description: Rendered identity sentence recorded at emission (the resolved 'env_info_model' prompt section). When absent/invalid the renderer rebuilds it from identity

attachment_nested_memory.description: A CLAUDE.md-family memory file discovered in a nested directory (or on the cwd path) when the model touches a file there. Rendered as 'Contents of <path>:\n\n<content>'. Not emitted when the file is already in readFileState or loadedNestedMemoryPaths.

path.description: Absolute path of the memory file

displayPath.description: Path relative to the cwd, for display

path.description: Absolute path of the memory file

content.description: Processed file content (HTML comments stripped, @-includes expanded)

globs.description: Frontmatter path globs the rule applies to

contentDiffersFromDisk.description: True when processing changed the text; the attachment is then treated as a partial view

rawContent.description: Unprocessed on-disk text, present only when contentDiffersFromDisk

parent.description: Path of the memory file that @-included this one

attachment_opened_file_in_ide.description: The user opened a file in the connected IDE. Rendered as 'The user opened the file <f> in the IDE.'

attachment_output_style.description: Per-turn output-style reminder while a non-default output style is active. Rendered as '<style> output style is active. <turnReminder or 'Remember to follow the specific guidelines for this style.'>'. Names longer than the style-name cap are suppressed ('Output style name exceeds').

turnReminder.description: Style-specific reminder text (the style's waitingTurnReminder while a foreground background-task is running, else its turnReminder); omitted when the style defines none

attachment_output_style_instructions.description: Output-style body announcement (context-announcement family, observed from 2.1.251): the style prompt that used to be a system-prompt section. Emitted when the configured style differs from the last announced one. Rendered as '# Output Style: <name>\n<prompt>', or 'The output style was reset to the default. Respond in your usual style.' when style is null. Produced by the 'session_settings' attachment producer together with the `language` subtype.

style.description: The active style, or null when reset to the default

attachment_output_token_usage.description: Output-token usage reminder ('Output tokens — turn: ... · session: ...'). Renderer only: the 2.1.281 producer is stubbed to return nothing.

attachment_pdf_reference.description: @-mentioned PDF too large to attach. Rendered as 'PDF file: <f> (<n> pages, <size>). This PDF is too large to read all at once.'

attachment_peer_mention.description: @-mention of another Claude session (cross-session messaging). 'resolved' when exactly one candidate matches, 'ask' when several do. Rendered as 'The user @-mentioned the Claude session "<token>" (<where>) as @<mention>. If their message asks you to tell or ask that session something, use the built-in SendMessage tool'. Emission logs tengu_at_mention_peer_success / tengu_at_mention_peer_ask.

mention.description: The mention as typed, normalized, with any '[ref]' suffix

token.description: Name-and-ref token to pass as SendMessage `to`, e.g. 'artifact-revision [80cb72]'

where.description: Human location label, e.g. 'on this machine'

candidates.description: Matching sessions (one when resolved; capped list when ask)

total.description: Total number of matching sessions (1 when resolved)

attachment_plan_file_reference.description: Plan file carried across compaction. Rendered as 'A plan file exists from plan mode at: <path>\n\nPlan contents:' ... 'If this plan is relevant to the current work and not already complete, continue working on it.'

planFilePath.description: Absolute path of the plan file

attachment_plan_mode.description: Plan-mode system reminder, re-emitted every few turns while plan mode is active (full every Nth, sparse otherwise). Rendered starting 'Plan mode is active. The user indicated that they do not want you to execute yet'; the full form carries '## Plan File Info:'. Workshop/prototype offers log plan_workshop_offer, plan_workshop_active, plan_prototype_offer.

isSubAgent.description: True when emitted inside a subagent

planFilePath.description: Plan file path for this session/agent

planExists.description: Whether the plan file already exists

customInstructions.description: SDK planModeInstructions body replacing the default phases; omitted when unset

workshopDocPath.description: Workshop doc path (currently always undefined, so omitted)

workshopOfferDocPath.description: Workshop doc path offered on the first full reminder

workshopActiveDocPath.description: Workshop doc path when a plan workshop is active

prototypeOffer.description: Present (true) when the prototype offer is included

attachment_plan_mode_exit.description: One-shot reminder after leaving plan mode. Rendered as '## Exited Plan Mode\n\nYou have exited plan mode. You can now make edits, run tools, and take actions.' plus ' The plan file is located at <path> if you need to reference it.' when planExists.

attachment_plan_mode_reentry.description: Emitted on re-entering plan mode when a plan file from an earlier planning session exists. Rendered as '## Re-entering Plan Mode' / 'You are returning to plan mode after having previously exited it.'

workshopDocPath.description: Workshop doc path (currently always undefined, so omitted)

attachment_poll_events.description: Wake/poll events delivered to the model (queued poll-event commands), or a marker that events were delivered via the poll tool / value dispatch (deliveredVia set; renders to nothing). No rendered field is stamped for this subtype. Record timestamp comes from attachment.timestamp.

media.description: Per-event media, present when any event carries media

provenance.description: Per-event provenance array (or the poll tool's provenance)

deliveredVia.description: Present when the events reached the model another way

attachment_prefix_delta.description: Text appended to the conversation when the request prefix changed mid-session (e.g. tool additions); rendered verbatim.

attachment_proactivity.description: Named in type sets (context-announcement set); no constructor or renderer in 2.1.281, payload unknown.

attachment_prompt_render_point.description: Marker that the recorded system prompt must be re-rendered at this point (SDK set_model with a system prompt). Renders to nothing; excluded from API history.

cause.description: Why the render point was placed

attachment_prompt_snapshot.description: Recorded system prompt (and, when known, tool definitions) that the session replays verbatim on later requests and resumes until compaction. Written on the first request of a session (source 'live_recorded') and re-written when new tools must be added to the snapshot or the reminder-fold decision is first recorded. Gated by the SDK initialize option systemPromptSnapshot ("Record the conversation's system prompt once and reuse it verbatim on every later request and resume") and on by default outside CLAUDE_CODE_SIMPLE; forced on for CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_KIND=bg and CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE. Renders to nothing (never sent to the model as a message); excluded from API history with prompt_render_point and deferred_tools_record. tengu_reminder_fold_recorded logs the fold decision.

systemPrompt.description: System prompt blocks verbatim, including the '__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__' marker block

schema.description: Full wire tool definition (name, description, input_schema, eager_input_streaming, ...)

server.description: MCP server name for MCP tools

tools.description: Recorded tool definitions; omitted on the first record when no earlier snapshot supplied them

cliPrefix.description: Recorded identity prefix block, one of the fixed 'You are Claude Code, Anthropic's official CLI for Claude...' / '...running within the Claude Agent SDK.' / 'You are a Claude agent, built on Anthropic's Claude Agent SDK.' strings

reminderFold.description: Recorded value of the reminder-fold experiment flag (tengu_chair_sermon), pinned for the session

hostPrompt.description: Legacy (2.1.261-2.1.263): hash of the host-supplied system prompt used to invalidate the snapshot; no longer written or read in 2.1.281

attachment_queued_command.description: A user prompt or task notification that was queued while the model was busy and delivered mid-turn (also: peer/channel messages drained from the agent inbox, and forwarded owner-intent turns for subagents). Rendered with provenance framing, e.g. '[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION - NOT USER INPUT]' for task notifications or 'Another Claude session sent a message while you were working:' for peers. Record timestamp is taken from attachment.timestamp when present. Carries rendered/renderedInHumanTurn at the record level (see attachmentRecord).

prompt.description: Prompt text, or content blocks (a text block followed by pasted image blocks) when images were attached

source_uuid.description: UUID of the queued input (becomes the rendered user message's uuid)

commandMode.description: Queue mode of the delivered command; the attachment producer only drains these two modes. Absent on inbox-drained peer messages and forwarded-intent turns

origin.description: Provenance of the queued input (task-notification origins are reduced to kind/subkind/fireReason)

handback.description: peer: message is a subagent handback

senderTaskId.description: peer/observer: task id of an in-process sender

body.description: peer: decoded body with the envelope stripped

verifiedPeerPid.description: peer: kernel-verified pid of the connecting process

timestamp.description: ISO time the command was queued; also used as the record timestamp

imagePasteIds.description: Paste ids of image blocks appended to prompt

fileAttachments.description: Host-supplied file attachments carried with the prompt

inlinedImagePaths.description: Image paths inlined into the prompt (re-announced via an inlined_image_paths reminder)

usage.description: Background-agent usage carried by a task-notification

taskDelivery.description: Background-task delivery descriptor (dropped once the task's output was fetched)

forwardedIntent.description: Owner-intent forwarding marker for a subagent (tengu agent_intent_forward); prompt is rendered as the forwarded owner turn

lineage.description: Lineage id of the forwarded owner turn

humanTurn.description: Present (true) when this queued prompt is a genuine human turn (prompt mode, not meta, human origin)

verifiedSlackHumanTurn.description: Present when the prompt is a verified Slack human turn

projectsUserTurn.description: Present when the prompt is a Projects user turn

hearthRelayRows.description: Slack relay rows backing the prompt

batchedRelayPrompts.description: On the head of a run of consecutive verified-Slack prompts: all prompts of the run, rendered together

renderedByBatchHead.description: Present on non-head members of a batched relay run; renders to nothing

attachment_read_truncation_notice.description: Banner emitted after a Read tool result that returned only a partial view. Rendered from banner, e.g. '[Truncated: PARTIAL view — <path>: showing lines 1-N of M total (T tokens, cap C). Call Read with offset=...'.

toolUseID.description: tool_use id of the Read call

attachment_relevant_memories.description: Memory files retrieved as possibly relevant to the user's message. Rendered as 'Retrieved for possible relevance — use only if it actually applies to what the user asked.' then '<header>\n\n<content>' per memory.

content.description: File content (possibly truncated with a '> This memory file was truncated' note)

header.description: 'Memory: <path>:' header, with an age caveat when older than a day

attachment_remote_session_change.description: Remote-session attribution reminder: the commit/PR trailer lines to use from here on. Rendered as 'Attribution for git commits and pull requests you create from here on (this replaces Claude Code's own earlier attribution guidance, such as a previous copy of this reminder; ...)' or 'From here on, do not add attribution lines ...'; with sendUserFileHint adds 'The user can follow this conversation from another device'. Belongs to the context-announcement set (preserved across compaction).

sendUserFileHint.description: Append the hint about sending files to the user's other device

managedCommit.description: Commit line is set by organization managed settings

managedPr.description: PR line is set by organization managed settings

attachment_repl_mcp_needs_auth.description: Renderer returns nothing; no constructor in 2.1.281, payload unknown.

attachment_sandbox_instructions.description: Sandbox boundary instructions, emitted when the Bash tool is present and the text changed. Empty content renders a default note. Context-announcement set member.

attachment_secondary_reminder.description: Secondary request-time reminder injected into the API request only (not persisted); persisted counterpart is secondary_reminder_sent.

attachment_secondary_reminder_sent.description: Persisted record that a secondary reminder was sent after a given point (mirror of batching_reminder_sent). Renders to nothing.

model.description: Model the reminder was sent to

attachment_selected_lines_in_diff.description: Lines the user selected in the IDE diff view. Rendered as 'The user selected the following N lines from the diff view (in <f>):'.

attachment_selected_lines_in_ide.description: Lines the user selected in the IDE editor. Rendered as 'The user selected the lines A to B from <f>:'.

attachment_session_context.description: Session-context announcement (context-announcement family, observed from 2.1.251): the userContext / systemContext keys userEmail, attachedProject, gitStatus and perforceMode that used to be appended to the system prompt. First copy renders as 'As you answer the user's questions, you can use the following context:' with '# <key>' sections and 'IMPORTANT: this context may or may not be relevant to your tasks.'; an update renders 'The session context was re-read <reason phrase>; these values replace the earlier ones:'. Emission logs tengu_context_announcement.

context.description: Announced context values (only these four keys are recognized)

changed.description: Present (true) when this replaces an earlier announcement

reason.description: Why the context was re-read (present with changed)

attachment_silent_turn_reminder.description: Nudge after several tool-only turns with no user-visible text; emission logs silent_turn_reminder. Rendered from text, e.g. 'The user hasn't heard from you in a while — say in a few words what you're doing, then continue.'

attachment_skill_listing.description: Skill listing for the Skill tool (initial full listing, then deltas). Rendered as 'The following skills are available for use with the Skill tool:\n\n<content>'. Transcript load drops the record when names exceeds 4096 entries or any name exceeds 512 chars.

isInitial.description: First listing of the session (vs. a delta)

names.description: Listed skill names (absent on older records)

attachment_structured_output.description: Validated output of the StructuredOutput tool (--json-schema / SDK jsonSchema). Renders to nothing; consumed by the SDK result. Excluded from rewind/branch point computation with inlined_image_paths and mcp_resource.

data.description: The structured output value as returned by the tool (normally an object matching the requested schema)

toolUseID.description: tool_use id of the StructuredOutput call (absent on older records)

attachment_task_reminder.description: Periodic nudge when the Task* tools (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate) haven't been used recently. Rendered as 'The task tools haven't been used recently.' plus 'Here are the existing tasks:' with '#<id>. [<status>] <subject>' lines. Transcript load drops it unless content is an array of objects.

attachment_task_status.description: Background-task status reminder. Emitted post-compaction for still-relevant local agents/shells and by the 'unified_tasks' producer for task deltas. Rendered as 'Background shell <id> ("<desc>") is still running' / 'Background agent "<desc>" (<id>) is still running.' / 'Task "<desc>" (<id>) was stopped by the user.' / 'Task <id> (type: ...) (status: ...)'.

deltaSummary.description: Progress summary (running agents) or error (finished), else null

toolUseId.description: tool_use id that started the shell

attachment_team_context.description: Agent-team identity for a teammate, emitted before its first assistant turn. Rendered as '# Team Coordination\n\nYou are a teammate in this session's agent team.'

attachment_teammate_mailbox.description: Teammate mailbox messages (agent teams). Renderer only in 2.1.281: the 'teammate_mailbox' producer returns nothing.

attachment_teammate_shutdown_batch.description: UI-only collapse of consecutive teammate-shutdown rows; synthesized for display, not written by the transcript writer. Renders to nothing.

attachment_thinking_drop.description: Diagnostic record: the API reported that previously sent thinking blocks were dropped (block binding prefix/model mismatch). Renders to nothing; excluded from API history. Block hashes carry forward to avoid re-reporting.

requestedBehavior.description: Requested block_binding prefix_mismatch_behavior sent with the request; omitted when none

thinkingBlocksSent.description: Thinking blocks sent in the request

thinkingTurnsSent.description: Assistant turns carrying thinking in the request

newlyDropped.description: Summary of the newly dropped blocks

blockHashes.description: xxHash64 (base36) of each newly dropped block

firstReportForThreadInProcess.description: First drop report for this thread in this process

kinds.description: Comma-joined client-side change kinds, e.g. 'messagesHistoryChanged' or 'none'

firstChangedMessageIndex.description: First message index that changed vs. the previous request, -1 when none

attachment_thinking_stripped.description: Marker that thinking blocks before this point were stripped from the API history (e.g. model switch or relay thinking strip). Renders to nothing.

scope.description: 'all' strips every earlier thinking block; 'partial' strips from `from` onward

from.description: partial only: first stripped thinking block

attachment_thread_state.description: Projects thread state: time since the user last wrote and replies since. Rendered as 'Thread state: the user last wrote <X> ago. Claude has sent N replies since then.'

repliesSinceUser.description: Replies since the user's last message

attachment_todo_reminder.description: Periodic nudge when TodoWrite hasn't been used recently (legacy todo list; suppressed when the Task* tools are active). Rendered as 'The TodoWrite tool hasn't been used recently.' plus 'Here are the existing contents of your todo list:'.

attachment_token_usage.description: Context-window usage reminder, only with CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TOKEN_USAGE_ATTACHMENT. Rendered as 'Token usage: <used>/<total>; <remaining> remaining'.

attachment_tool_host_result_lines.description: Remote tool-host provenance lines for one tool result. Renders to nothing.

attachment_tool_hosts_correction.description: Correction to the tool-hosts notice (logs line_count). Lines rendered verbatim.

attachment_tool_hosts_notice.description: Tool-hosts notice listing remote tool hosts. Lines rendered verbatim.

attachment_tool_search_usage_reminder.description: Reminder that some tool schemas are not loaded yet. Rendered as 'Some available tools' schemas are not loaded in this conversation yet:'. Logs tengu_juniper_shoal_shown.

attachment_total_tokens_reminder.description: Per-turn remaining-token-budget reminder; rendered from text, e.g. '<total_tokens>15000000 tokens left</total_tokens>'.

attachment_ultra_effort_enter.description: Ultracode on. Rendered as 'Ultracode is on: optimize for the most exhaustive, correct answer' (full) or 'Ultracode is still on' (sparse). Logs tengu_ultra_effort.

attachment_ultra_effort_exit.description: Ultracode off: 'Ultracode is off — the Workflow tool's standard opt-in rule applies again.'

attachment_ultrathink_effort.description: The user typed 'ultrathink'. Rendered as 'The user included the keyword "ultrathink", requesting deeper reasoning on this turn.' Logs tengu_ultrathink.

attachment_unknown_command_fallback.description: An unknown slash command was typed and passed to the model with suggestions.

attachment_workflow_keyword_request.description: The user typed 'ultracode'. Rendered as 'The user included the keyword "ultracode", opting this turn into multi-agent orchestration'. Logs tengu_workflow_keyword.

attachment_workflow_size_guideline_chang.description: Workflow size guideline changed mid-session. Rendered as 'The workflow size guideline for this session changed: ...' or 'Workflow size is now unrestricted — no size guideline applies.'

size.description: New size guideline ('unrestricted' or a size tier)
